INDEPENDENT REVIEW OF 1.24.40'S PDF TOOLS (review 1) -- 2026-11-25
Build: the frozen lantern_1240.inner.html (sha256 78ee1a3b49a0327e...), loaded as the page in Chromium (Playwright).
Line numbers below are of that file. I did not write the code and did not change src/.

How it was tried: 32 PDFs made here by programs that are not Lantern (reportlab, pikepdf hand-written content,
qpdf, pdflatex, xelatex, LibreOffice, Chromium's own Save as PDF, tesseract), plus two picture-heavy PDFs made at
run time. Every result was read by qpdf, poppler (pdftotext, -bbox, pdftoppm, pdfimages), pypdf, pdftk and, for
redaction, tesseract reading the redacted page back. make_fixtures.py says how each PDF is made; cases.json lists
every check and what was seen.
  run_redact.py   668 checks, 86 failed (some of them the oracle's strictness: see the note at the end of item 1)
  run_tools.py    239 checks, 31 failed
  run_tile.py      16 checks,  8 failed (the tile clicked through, in Chromium)
  run_regress.py   44 + 44 checks, 0 failed (against 1.24.38 and against the 1.24.39 working tree)
Usage: python3 make_fixtures.py; python3 run_redact.py <build.html> <outdir> (the same for run_tools.py, run_tile.py;
run_regress.py <new.html> <old.html> <outdir>).

=====================================================================================================================
FAILURES, most serious first
=====================================================================================================================

1. REDACT LEAVES WORDS VISIBLE, OR IN THE FILE, WHEN THEY ARE NOT DRAWN LEVEL ON THE BASELINE  (a leak)
   Words drawn turned (a vertical label on a drawing, a chart's axis title, a line in a form XObject placed turned,
   Chromium's CSS-rotated text, every line of a landscape page whose drawing is turned under /Rotate 90), raised with
   text rise (Ts), upside down, or in a Type 3 font with its own FontMatrix:
   a) "Mark them all" puts the black box in the wrong place and the word stays readable in the redacted copy
      (tesseract reads it back from poppler's picture of the copy):
        t_fonts.pdf     TREMONTANE (vertical label)   Lantern's mark [516 196 524 211]; poppler: x 511-522, y 452-618
                                                       -> an 8x15 pt black box at the label's foot, the word whole above it
                        ZEPHYRINE (raised 18 pt)       mark on the baseline [180 516 255 531]; the word is at y 535-546
                        BELLWEATHER (upside down)      27% of the word left uncovered
        t_landscape.pdf ALDERGROVE, Vasquez            marks [67 68 77 85] and [97 68 107 85]: tiny boxes at two line
                                                       starts (they also black out "La" and "Re"); both words readable.
                                                       Same through the tile (run_tile.py: Redact, Mark them all, Apply,
                                                       Save -> tesseract reads "Station ALDERGROVE pressures").
        t_xobj.pdf      NIGHTJAR in the copy of the form placed turned 90: 19% covered, readable
        t_chrome.pdf    MARGINALIA (CSS rotate(-90deg)): the marks went onto two other lines; readable
        t_type3.pdf     PELLINORE: the mark is 18 pt wide for a 76 pt word (FontMatrix 0.01 ignored)
   b) A box dragged over such a word where it is seen (the tile's drag, or an area given to redact()): the picture is
      black there, but the word is kept in the invisible words written over the picture, in plain Helvetica, render
      mode 3 -- pdftotext, pypdf, Acrobat's search and copy all get it back:
        t_fonts.pdf p1 (and its /Rotate 90 copy): "VERTICAL LABEL TREMONTANE", "Before the raised word ZEPHYRINE
        after it.", "UPSIDE DOWN BELLWEATHER" all still in pdftotext's words of the redacted page; t_landscape.pdf:
        "ALDERGROVE" and "Vasquez"; t_xobj.pdf: "NIGHTJAR"; t_type3.pdf: "PELLINORE".
        Through the tile too (run_tile.py: a box dragged over TREMONTANE as seen, Apply, Save: pdftotext and pypdf
        read "VERTICAL LABEL TREMONTANE" on page 1 of the saved file).
   Smallest reproduction:
        reportlab: c.translate(520, 200); c.rotate(90); c.drawString(0, 0, "VERTICAL LABEL TREMONTANE")
        var t = await P.pageText(pdf, 0); P.redactMarks(t.boxes, "tremontane")      -> [[515.8,196.4,524.2,211.4]]
        await P.redact(pdf, {areas: [{page: 0, rect: [509, 450, 525, 620]}]}) ; pdftotext -> "VERTICAL LABEL TREMONTANE"
   Likely cause:
     - PDF_TEXT show() (49029-49042) keeps only x0 = m[4], y0 = m[5], x1 = m2[4] and letter starts cx = m[0]*adv + m[4]:
       the run's direction (m[1], m[2]) is never kept, so a turned run becomes a level box at its first letter.
     - PDF_TEXT has no Ts case in its operators (49057-49103): a raised run is put on the baseline (PDF_DRAW does
       raise it, so the picture and the marks disagree).
     - PDF_TEXT font() (48964-49001) reads Type 3 Widths as thousandths (49036 F.width(c) / 1000) and never reads
       FontMatrix.
     - PDF_TEXT groups runs into lines by y alone (49129-49135): on the landscape page all three lines start at the
       same y (in the page's own space) and become one "line"; Chromium's sideways letters join every level line.
     - PDF_REDACT marksOf() (52410-52439) makes level boxes from those; invisible() (52280-52290) tests a level box
       at the baseline (52284) and writes every line level (52287).
   Direction: keep each run's matrix (and rise, and the Type 3 FontMatrix); mark the bounding box of the run's four
   corners; on a marked page, leave out of the invisible words any run that is not level (or test its corners), and
   write the others with their own matrix. Until then, a run that is not level should never be marked by "Mark them
   all" without saying so, and never kept as invisible words on a marked page.
   (Why it matters: vertical labels on drawings, chart axis titles, table headers and landscape pages are common,
   and a redacted copy is sent to people who must not read what was taken out.)
   Note on the oracle: run_redact.py's "latex_find ... office 0.93" and "latex_area ... tesseract reads office" are the
   oracle matching "officer," and other words with "office" in them, and "annots_find ... nowhere else" counts page 2's
   own comment twice: not failures of Lantern. "annots_find_flatfirst: page 2 drawn as before" fails because Redact
   flattens every page's comments first (the tile asks before it does): by design.

2. A PDF WITH MORE THAN ONE OBJECT STREAM OPENS AS 0 PAGES, AND EVERY TOOL WRITES AN EMPTY PDF FROM IT
   (in PDF_PARSE, already in 1.24.38 and 1.24.39; worse now, because the new tools write copies from it)
   t_many_objstm.pdf (reportlab, 120 pages; qpdf --object-streams=generate packs 100 objects a stream: two streams):
   the tile says "0 pages."; i_objstm_text.pdf (pikepdf, 60 pages, six object streams, 243 KB): Reduce size wrote a
   309-byte PDF with no pages and called it 0 pictures smaller; Stamp, Pages, Protect etc. would do the same.
   Lantern reads the catalog as one of the link annotations.
   Smallest reproduction: qpdf --object-streams=generate on any PDF of more than ~100 objects; P.open(...).count === 0.
   Likely cause: PDF_PARSE 47618-47634: packed[key] = function () { var l2 = new Lexer(txt); l2.p = first + pr[1]; ... }
   (47631) closes over the loop's var txt and var first, so every packed object is read from the LAST object
   stream's text at its own offset. One object stream (the existing fixtures) hides it. Fix: build each stream's
   functions in a function of its own (txt, first as parameters). Also: a tool should refuse to write a PDF of 0 pages.

3. EDIT TEXT ON A LANDSCAPE PAGE DELETES LINES NOBODY TOUCHED, AND WRITES THE NEW LINE SIDEWAYS
   t_landscape.pdf (/Rotate 90, the drawing turned so the words read across as seen): the tile shows one tappable box
   (20 x 58 px) for the three lines; a tap offers "Landscape report: ... Reading taken by ... This line is kept and must
   stay where it is." as one line; changing it takes out all three lines and writes one line, level in the page's own
   space, i.e. running up the page as seen (poppler's box for it is 13 x 82 pt, upright).
   A vertical label changed (t_fonts.pdf TREMONTANE) is written level from the label's foot and runs off the page:
   poppler finds none of the new words.
   Likely cause: as 1 (PDF_TEXT 49129-49135 grouping by y; no direction kept), and PDF_EDIT_TEXT pieces() (52756-52769)
   and editText (52792: new words always "1 0 0 1 x y Tm"). Direction: refuse a line that is not level (say so), or
   keep its matrix for the new words.

4. COMBINE DROPS THE FORM OF EVERY PDF BUT THE FIRST
   combine([t_latex.pdf, f_form.pdf]): the form's widgets are copied onto its page, but the new file's AcroForm is the
   first PDF's (none), so pypdf get_fields() -> {} and pdftk dump_data_fields -> nothing; Acrobat would not let anyone
   fill them. Two copies of one form combined: 30 widgets on the pages, 11 fields in /AcroForm /Fields.
   Lantern's own P.fields still lists them (it walks the pages' annotations), which is why tests/pdf_edit.js passes.
   Likely cause: PDF_EDIT_PAGES combine(), 51380: keepCatalog only for k === 0. Direction: merge every PDF's
   /Fields (and DR fonts); a name already used by an earlier PDF renamed (Acrobat merges same-named fields into one
   value, which surprises people with two copies of one form).

5. STAMP: ONE SEE-THROUGH SETTING A PAGE, SHARED BY EVERYTHING STAMPED, AND OVERWRITTEN BY THE NEXT STAMP
   a) page numbers and a DRAFT watermark (opacity 0.3) in one stamp(): the page numbers are drawn at 30% too
      (mean grey 241 against 208 without the watermark).
   b) the tile's ordinary flow, Watermark then Page numbers (two Applies): the second stamp sets the page's /LtnGS to
      /ca 1, and the first stamp's DRAFT (drawn with /LtnGS gs) becomes solid red over the page's words
      (qpdf --qdf shows /LtnGS << /ca 1 >> on both pages; picture in tile_stamped_twice.pdf).
   Likely cause: PDF_EDIT_STAMP 51613-51614: one ExtGState named LtnGS per page, ca = the smallest opacity of all items,
   and the same name written again by the next stamp. Direction: one ExtGState per item, under a name the page's
   resources do not already use (the same for the fonts LtnF/LtnFB).

6. COMMENTS, NEW FORM BOXES AND FILLED FIELDS ON A PAGE TURNED 90 ARE DRAWN SIDEWAYS AS THE PAGE IS SEEN
   - addAnnots on t_fonts_rot90.pdf: a text box and a stamp read up the page (poppler, after qpdf --flatten-annotations:
     "ROTATEDNOTE" box 11 x 91 pt, "APPROVED" 8 x 50 pt). Acrobat writes these upright (/Rotate on the annotation, its
     drawing turned). The signature picture the same way (not checked by picture).
   - addFields on t_fonts_rot90.pdf, then fillForm: the typed words read up the page (box 11 x 63 pt).
   - fillForm on f_rot_form.pdf, a field that says it is turned with its page (/MK /R 90, as Acrobat makes it):
     drawn level in the page's own space, so sideways as seen (box 11 x 37 pt).
   Likely cause: PDF_EDIT_ANNOT addAnnots (51947-51983) and PDF_FORM_MAKE addFields (53001-53017) never look at the
   page's /Rotate; PDF_EDIT_FORMS fillForm (51825) and appearance() (51703-51753) ignore /MK /R. Scanned landscape
   forms are usually pages turned 90, so this is the common case for "fill in a scanned form".

7. EDIT TEXT LEAVES THE OLD WORDS IN /ActualText
   t_actualtext.pdf: "/Span <</ActualText (Torque 45 Nm)>> BDC (Torque 45 Nm) Tj EMC": after changing the line to
   "Torque 60 Nm", the Tj is gone but the BDC with "Torque 45 Nm" stays around the [n] TJ that replaced it: "45 Nm" is
   still in the page's drawing, and Acrobat's copy and read-aloud use ActualText. Cause: PDF_EDIT_TEXT 52794-52795 cuts
   only the showing operators. (Tagged PDFs from Word use /ActualText and /Alt.)

8. REDACT'S SEARCHABLE WORDS: PLACED WRONG ON MULTI-COLUMN LINES, LOST ON TURNED PAGES; LINKS DROPPED; UNSEEN WORDS KEPT
   - A marked page's kept words are written one merged "line" at a time in Helvetica stretched to the line's width
     (52286-52287). On two-column pages the right column's words land up to 83 pt from where they are seen (t_fonts:
     "Right" 83.5, "fever" 73.3); Chromium's page up to 121 pt (its sideways letters stretch every line to x 402).
     A search hit is then highlighted in the wrong place and drag-select copies the wrong words.
   - A mark in one column takes the other column's words on the same baseline out of the searchable words
     (PDF_TEXT merges the two columns into one line; "a line a mark touches goes whole").
   - On the landscape page (turned drawing) the kept words are written level, so poppler finds none of the 15 in their
     places; slanted and vertical runs on any marked page likewise.
   - Links on a marked page are dropped (52317 drops all its annotations): t_latex.pdf page 1, 2 links -> 0.
   - Words never seen but on a marked page are written again as invisible words: outside the CropBox ("OUTSIDE THE
     CROP: unseen words", t_offset_box.pdf), off the page (MARCHETTI), render mode 3 (ROSKILDE). Not a new leak (they
     were in the file), but "each page with a mark becomes a picture of the page" suggests only what is seen stays,
     and Remove hidden does not take hidden words out either (Acrobat's does).
   Direction: write each run (each part) separately at its own place and matrix; keep only runs inside the page's
   seen box; keep link annotations no mark touches.

9. REDACT API: MARKS FOUND BEFORE FLATTENING MISS A TYPED COMMENT'S WORDS
   redactMarks(pageText(unflattened).boxes, "esmeralda") puts a FreeText's words at the top-left of its rectangle
   (PDF_TEXT 49121: y = r[3] - sz, x = r[0] .. r[2]); its drawing shows them 10 pt lower and 13 pt further left: the
   mark covers 37% of the word (a_annots.pdf, upright page and turned page). The tile flattens first and is right
   (annots_find_flatfirst passes). Either do the flatten inside the API path, or say in the API that marks must come
   from the flattened PDF.

10. REMOVE HIDDEN KEEPS A SCRIPT CHAINED UNDER ANOTHER ACTION
   t_scripts.pdf: a link whose /A is a GoTo with /Next << /S /JavaScript /JS (app.alert('NEXTSCRIPT')) >>: kept.
   Cause: PDF_REDACT sanitize clean() (52369-52375) looks at an action's top level only, and b.each visits only objects
   of their own, not dictionaries inside them. Also kept (perhaps by choice; worth a word in the dialog): SubmitForm
   actions (send the form's data to a web address) and GoToR/GoToE.

11. CATALOG ENTRIES LOST BY EVERY REWRITE
   PDF_EDIT_STAMP copyCatalog (51621-51627, used as P.keepCatalog by Stamp, Fill in, Flatten, Comment, Protect, Redact,
   Edit text, Reduce size, Make form) and PDF_EDIT_PAGES keepCatalog (51325-51330) do not copy: the catalog's own
   /Dests (named destinations the PDF 1.1 way: t_dests.pdf's link by name goes nowhere after a stamp), /OpenAction
   (the page and zoom it opens at), /Metadata, /MarkInfo, /StructTreeRoot, /OutputIntents (a tagged PDF or a PDF/A stops
   being one after any change). pagesOut also drops /PageLabels when every page is kept in its order (t_dests.pdf).
   The structure tree is dropped on purpose (comment at 51323-51324); the others look like omissions.

12. REDUCE SIZE: A PICTURE WITH /Mask LOSES ITS MASK
   i_images.pdf pages 6 and 7 (made by make_fixtures.make_big): an RGB picture with a stencil-mask /Mask and one with a
   colour-key /Mask [250 255 250 255 250 255]: after Reduce size the masked-out parts are drawn (a white background where
   the red page showed through). PDF_COMPRESS 52910-52912 builds the new picture's dictionary with SMask and
   Interpolate only. Direction: skip pictures with /Mask (a colour key cannot survive JPEG anyway), or copy a stencil
   /Mask.

13. FILL IN AND MAKE FORM, SMALLER THINGS
   - A comb field (Ff comb, MaxLen 6) is drawn as plain text at the left (AB12CD across 152-199 of a 150-270 box), not one
     letter a cell as Acrobat and poppler draw it; Flatten then keeps that look. (51825)
   - A radio value that is none of its buttons ('Sunday'): every button turned Off, /V left at /Day (51813).
   - A list box's /I (selected index) left at the old choice when /V changes (the standard says /V wins; some
     viewers show /I). (51818-51822)
   - Make form lets a box take the name of an existing parent field ("addr" beside addr.street, addr.city): the check
     (52982-52987) compares full names of fields only, not their parents.
   - Words beyond WinAnsi in a text box, a field, a stamp or Edit text are changed in the drawing: "≤" drawn
     "<=", "Ω" drawn "Ohm" (the comment's /Contents and the field's /V keep what was typed, so the drawing and
     the value differ). Fair as a fallback; it should be said, as Edit text says "in Helvetica".

14. SMALLER STILL
   - Bates digits above 12 come out short: digits 15 -> "X0000000000007" (13 characters). PDF_EDIT_STAMP 51600 pads
     with "000000000000".
   - pagesOut({order: [0, 1]}) on a 1-page PDF: no error; the page index past the end still counts, so every bookmark
     then points at nothing (51359-51363).
   - pagesOut with the same page twice ({order: [0, 0, 1]}): both copies share the same widget and comment objects
     (12 shared on f_form.pdf; a widget must belong to one page). The tile has no "duplicate", so API only.

15. WHERE TIMES WORDS SIT DEPENDS ON THE BROWSER'S "serif" FONT (a caution about the 1.24.40 width change)
   With Chromium's serif here (Liberation Serif, metric-compatible with Times New Roman, as Windows has), Times words
   now sit within 0.1 pt of poppler's (Smithfield 348.3-399.0 both; Courier exact; Helvetica exact). With a browser
   whose serif is DejaVu Serif (simulated: FONTCONFIG_FILE=fonts_dejavu.conf, in this folder, before starting Chromium), the same line comes out about 25% wider: "Smithfield" placed at 415-487 against poppler's 348-399.
   Lantern's own picture uses the same widths, so a redacted picture is still covered where Lantern drew the word;
   but the page as drawn, searched and edited differs from other viewers, and Edit text's [n] TJ move (52771-52775)
   would shift the words after a changed piece by the difference. Cause: PDF_TEXT stdWidth (49006-49019) measures
   Times with the browser's "serif". Direction: a built-in width table for Times-Roman/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic (the
   14 standard fonts' widths are published figures), as Helvetica already has.

=====================================================================================================================
WHAT PASSED
=====================================================================================================================
Redaction
 - Words drawn level, in Helvetica, Times (no widths), Courier, Times Bold/Italic, Tz 150, Tc 3, Tw 10, in two
   columns, on pages turned 90 and 270, with a CropBox offset, with a MediaBox not starting at 0 0, in a form XObject
   placed level (also scaled 1.5), in pdflatex (ligatures), xelatex (Type 0), LibreOffice (TrueType, tagged),
   Chromium (Type 0, flipped matrix), tesseract's scan with invisible words, after an inline image whose data holds
   "EI", over three content streams, in a locked PDF, in an incremental update: found, marked, and gone: not in
   poppler's or pypdf's words of the page, not held by anything the page holds (pikepdf walk), nowhere else in the
   file, black where poppler showed the word, not read by tesseract (four turns).
 - Pages not marked: drawing byte for byte as before; every page keeps its turn and seen box.
 - The earlier revision of an incrementally updated page is not in the copy; the LibreOffice structure tree is not
   carried; a note, an attached file and a typed comment on a marked page are not held by it, while page 2's are kept.
 - White text and text under a white box inside a marked area go; text in a layer that is off is not carried.
 - The tile: Mark them all + a dragged box, 3 marks shown, Apply, Save, qpdf clean.
Edit text
 - Lines changed in Helvetica, Times without widths, embedded TrueType, pdflatex, xelatex (Type 0), Chromium,
   LibreOffice, tesseract's words, three content streams, after an inline image, a locked PDF, an offset MediaBox, a
   page turned 90 (level words): old words gone from the page and from everything it holds, new words read by poppler
   and pypdf, qpdf clean, every other word within 0.6 pt of where poppler had it, including the unit after a changed
   value moved by TJ (Helvetica, Times, TrueType) and lines placed by Td after the changed one.
 - A line drawn from a form XObject refused, and said.
Protect
 - AES-256 R6 opened by qpdf, pypdf and poppler with the user password; the owner password (non-ASCII) opens it as
   owner; the limits asked read back exactly by qpdf; a wrong password refused; words identical to the original.
 - Non-ASCII + emoji passwords, a 140-character password (qpdf and pypdf; poppler cannot open qpdf's own file with that
   password either, so not Lantern's fault), an NFD-typed password opened with the NFC one.
 - A PDF locked with AES-128 relocked: the new password opens it, the old does not. A form with object streams,
   linearized: qpdf clean, fields read by pypdf. Info and bookmarks read back after decrypting.
Stamp
 - Upright at top-left and bottom-right where the page is seen on pages turned 90 and 270, a CropBox page, an offset
   MediaBox page, the landscape page, and a page whose Rotate/MediaBox/Resources are inherited from the page tree.
 - Comments, form fields and page labels kept; a file name with ü and € stamped as written.
Pages: reorder and turn; inherited Rotate turned once more (180) and MediaBox/Resources kept.
Combine: a locked PDF and one with object streams: qpdf clean, unlocked, words kept.
Fill in: every kind on f_form.pdf read back by pypdf (text, multiline, password masked in the drawing, check, radio
 group -- only Night on, combo by export value, list, right-aligned drawn at the right edge, parent/kids, one field on
 two pages); ë and Å drawn as written; qpdf clean. Flatten looks as qpdf's own flattening (mean grey
 difference < 2); no fields left; a /CA 0.3 box stays see-through; only links left; typed comment's words in the page.
Make form on an existing form: old fields kept, new ones (a choice named Größe, a tick) read by pypdf.
Remove hidden: document and open-action scripts, XMP, Info author, page XMP and PieceInfo, page /AA, the Launch and
 JavaScript links, the attached file: all gone; the web link kept. The tile's dialog the same.
Reduce size (150 and 72 dpi): RGB, gray, CMYK JPEG with Decode [1 0 ...], indexed, SMask, gray Decode [1 0], 16-bit,
 small JPEG left alone, big JPEG, a picture through a form: each page looks as before (mean grey difference <= 4.3 at
 72 dpi, <= 0.3 at 150), file 4.75 MB -> 1.08 MB / 441 KB, qpdf clean.
   (pages 6 and 7, pictures with /Mask, did not: failure 12)
Export: page pictures the size the page is seen (turned 90, CropBox, offset box, inherited). Compare: a page with
 itself nothing; with its turned copy, changes.
Regressions: 31 PDFs (mine and the earlier fixtures) read and drawn by 1.24.38, 1.24.39 and 1.24.40: words read are
 identical between 1.24.39 and 1.24.40 on every page; drawings as near poppler's or nearer (Times pages 1.94 vs 1.95
 mean grey difference). Nothing threw or hung; no page errors in any run.
The tile at phone width (390 px): no bar off the screen, no sideways scroll.

=====================================================================================================================
NOT TESTED
=====================================================================================================================
 - Acrobat or Adobe Reader itself (none here); Word- or Acrobat-made PDFs (LibreOffice, LaTeX, Chromium, reportlab and
   pikepdf stand in). Firefox, Safari, Android Chrome (only Chromium on Linux).
 - XFA forms; PDFs with certificate signatures through Protect, Stamp or Fill in; JBIG2, JPX and CCITT pictures in
   Reduce size; very large PDFs (time, memory); printing; Measure; the guides; the AI side (Chat reading PDFs).
 - Redaction with dpi other than 200; Undo after Redact; Combine with a picture other than through the API.
 - The staged tests/pdf_edit.js now calls P.tablesOf, which the frozen build does not have; it stops there.
